claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the LG logo and the text 'Inverter DirectDrive 7kg' on the control panel.
The report and photos do not show the seller's location.

claims.claim: Barely used, bought new last year
claims.evidence: Photos show rust stains but no purchase date or usage history.
The report does not show whether the machine powers on or functions.
Internal motor condition is not shown in the photos.
Photos show a warranty sticker on the machine but not the receipt or warranty card.

risks.risk: Machine does not power on or complete a wash, spin, and drain cycle.
risks.proof: Video clip of the machine powering on, filling, agitating, spinning, and draining.

risks.risk: Actual age and usage exceed the seller's claim; rust may indicate older or heavier use.
risks.proof: Photo of the original receipt or purchase date, plus a clear shot of the serial number for age verification.
risks.if_unproven: as older than one year and possibly heavily used.

risks.risk: Motor or internal components have been opened or repaired.
risks.proof: Video or photos of the motor and internal panels with service records.

risks.risk: Water inlet and drain hoses are missing.
risks.proof: Photo of the hoses included with the machine.

risks.risk: Rust stains indicate corrosion, leaks, or structural weakness.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the rusted lower panel and bottom edge, plus a dry-run leak test.
risks.if_unproven: as having body corrosion and possible leaks.

proof_requests: Video of the machine powering on and running a full wash and spin cycle.
Photo of the original receipt showing the purchase date.
Photo of the warranty card and receipt.
Close-up photos of the rusted areas and a leak test.
Photo of the inlet and drain hoses.
response.reason: The witness identifies the item as an LG DirectDrive 7kg front-load washing machine from photo 0, so it can be priced at its worst case; condition and age claims are unproven.
